title: Claude Code Hooks Schema
description: Schema for Claude Code lifecycle hooks - https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

SessionStart.description: Hooks that run when a session begins or resumes

UserPromptSubmit.description: Hooks that run when the user submits a prompt

PreToolUse.description: Hooks that run before a tool is executed

PermissionRequest.description: Hooks that run when a permission dialog appears

PostToolUse.description: Hooks that run after a tool is executed

PostToolUseFailure.description: Hooks that run after a tool call fails

Notification.description: Hooks that run when a notification is triggered

SubagentStart.description: Hooks that run when a subagent is spawned

SubagentStop.description: Hooks that run when a subagent finishes

Stop.description: Hooks that run when the agent stops

StopFailure.description: Hooks that run when the agent stops due to a failure

TeammateIdle.description: Hooks that run when a teammate is about to go idle

TaskCompleted.description: Hooks that run when a task is being marked as completed

InstructionsLoaded.description: Hooks that run when instructions are loaded

ConfigChange.description: Hooks that run when configuration changes

WorktreeCreate.description: Hooks that run when a worktree is created

WorktreeRemove.description: Hooks that run when a worktree is removed

PreCompact.description: Hooks that run before context compaction

PostCompact.description: Hooks that run after context compaction

Elicitation.description: Hooks that run when an elicitation is triggered

ElicitationResult.description: Hooks that run when an elicitation result is received

SessionEnd.description: Hooks that run when a session terminates

hookMatcher.description: Hook matcher group with optional pattern filter and one or more hook handlers

matcher.description: Regex pattern to filter when the hook fires. What it matches depends on the event: tool name, session source, notification type, agent type, etc. Omit or use '*' to match all occurrences.

hooks.description: Array of hook handlers to execute when the matcher matches

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

once.description: Run the hook only once per session (skills only)

async.description: Run the hook in the background without blocking

if.description: Permission rule pattern to filter when this hook fires (e.g. Bash(git *), Edit(**/*.ts))

prompt.description: Prompt to evaluate with LLM. Use $ARGUMENTS placeholder for hook input JSON.

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

once.description: Run the hook only once per session (skills only)

model.description: Model to use for evaluation (defaults to a fast model)

if.description: Permission rule pattern to filter when this hook fires (e.g. Bash(git *), Edit(**/*.ts))

anyOf.description: Agent hook that spawns a subagent with tool access to verify conditions

prompt.description: Prompt describing what to verify. Use $ARGUMENTS placeholder for hook input JSON.

statusMessage.description: Custom spinner message displayed while the hook runs

model.description: Model to use for evaluation (defaults to a fast model)

if.description: Permission rule pattern to filter when this hook fires (e.g. Bash(git *), Edit(**/*.ts))
